name: pq-nonblock-tls
comment: TLS 1.3 driving the non-blocking ML-DSA and ML-KEM code through the software async device: --enable-dilithium=yes,nonblock and --enable-mlkem=yes,nonblock auto-enable asynccrypt-sw, and make check runs test_tls13_pq_nonblock_async (ML-DSA-44 certificate; ML-KEM-768 standalone, SecP256r1MLKEM768 and X25519MLKEM768 key shares, each also resumed with a session ticket) plus the cipher suite PQC tests with the example client and server polling WC_PENDING_E.

name: pq-nonblock-tls-mlkem-ecc-nonblock
comment: test_tls13_pq_nonblock_async with non-blocking ML-KEM but no ML-DSA, and non-blocking X25519, ECC and SP math, so the hybrid key shares pend in both halves

name: pq-mlkem-encap-only-tls
comment: A TLS server with ML-KEM encapsulation only: test_tls13_mlkem_encap_server feeds it a ClientHello with an ML-KEM-768, SecP256r1MLKEM768 or X25519MLKEM768 key share

name: pq-mlkem-encap-only-tls-nonblock
comment: The encapsulate-only TLS server with non-blocking ML-KEM: the pended encapsulation is finished from TLSX_KeyShare_Setup

name: pq-mlkem-make-only-tls-nonblock
comment: Build only: non-blocking ML-KEM with key generation and no encapsulation or decapsulation in a TLS build

name: pq-mldsa-make-only-tls-nonblock
comment: Build only: non-blocking ML-DSA with key generation and no signing or verification in a TLS build
